title: MatGel: A MATLAB program for quantitative analysis of 2D polyacrylamide electrophoresis (2D-PAGE) protein gel images
author: Tiwari, Williams, et al.

steps.title: Capture and save gel image
steps.instruction: Use a digital gel imaging system that matches the protein gel staining dye to acquire the 2D‑PAGE gel image, then save the image in an appropriate file format (tiff, jpeg, bmp, or jpg).

substeps.instruction: Set up the digital imaging system with the appropriate filter or settings for the staining dye used on the gel.
Capture the gel image using the system.
Save the captured image as a tiff, jpeg, bmp, or jpg file.
